findings.title: Call to isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() has no matching no-arg overload
findings.body: `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled()` is called with no arguments, but the only definition added in UsernamePasswordForm is `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel user)`, which requires a user. This will not compile. If it were made to compile with a user argument, the `user != null` condition inside would also be redundant with the `context.getUser() != null` check already in the same expression.

findings.title: Passkeys no longer set up on the first login page
findings.body: `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(user)` requires `user != null`. On the initial login page (no user yet), the old code called `webauthnAuth.fillContextForm`; now it is never called. Conditional-UI passkey login for unidentified users would break, and the same applies to the error challenge at line 137. The helper's `user != null` condition looks inverted for the non-reauth case. It also contradicts the tests, which still expect the webauthn form on the first page.
